name: Universal Numeric Types and Representations
description: Cross-language specifications of integer, floating-point, and fixed-point numeric types, bit widths, ranges, and precision limits.
when_to_retrieve: When translating numeric calculations between statically typed and dynamically typed languages
When evaluating potential precision loss between double float and exact decimal
When handling JavaScript Number 53-bit integer limit
when_not_to_retrieve: When performing string formatting with no numeric manipulation
retrieval_guidance: SAS stores all numbers as 64-bit double precision floats by default. JavaScript Number is 64-bit float with 53 bits of mantissa.
